verse.verse_1: About what are they asking one another?
verse.verse_2: Is it about the awesome tiding
verse.verse_3: that they are in utter disagreement?
verse.verse_4: No indeed; soon will they come to know;
verse.verse_5: again, no indeed; soon will they come to know.
verse.verse_6: Have We not spread the earth like a bed,
verse.verse_7: and fixed the mountains like pegs,
verse.verse_8: and created you in pairs (as men and women),
verse.verse_9: and made your sleep a means of repose,
verse.verse_10: and made the night a covering,
verse.verse_11: and made the day to seek livelihood,
verse.verse_12: and built above you seven strong firmaments,
verse.verse_13: and placed therein a hot, shining lamp,
verse.verse_14: and sent down abundant water from the clouds
verse.verse_15: so that We may thereby bring forth grain and vegetation,
verse.verse_17: Surely the Day of Judgement has an appointed time;
verse.verse_18: the Day when the Trumpet shall be blown, and you will come forth in multitudes;
verse.verse_19: and when the sky shall be opened up and will become all doors;
verse.verse_20: and the mountains will be set in motion and become a mirage.
verse.verse_21: Surely the Hell is an ambush,
verse.verse_23: therein they shall abide for ages,
verse.verse_24: they shall taste in it no coolness, nor any pleasant drink
verse.verse_25: save boiling water and wash of the wounds;
verse.verse_26: a befitting recompense for their deeds.
verse.verse_27: For indeed they did not look forward to any reckoning,
verse.verse_28: and roundly denied Our Signs as false.
verse.verse_29: And everything have We recorded in a Book.
verse.verse_30: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.
verse.verse_31: Surely the state of triumph awaits the God-fearing:
verse.verse_33: and youthful maidens of like age,
verse.verse_35: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, nor any falsehood;
verse.verse_36: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward
verse.verse_37: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of that which is between them; the Most Merciful Lord before Whom none dare utter a word.
verse.verse_38: The Day when the Spirit and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.
verse.verse_39: That Day is sure to come. So let him who will seek a resort with his Lord.
verse.verse_40: Lo! We warn you of a chastisement near at hand; the Day when a man will look on what his own hands have sent forth, and the unbelievers shall say: “Oh would that I were utter dust.”
